# Saved trips

<!-- Generated by modules/core/tools/generate_index.py; edit the registry or the hooks, not these lines. -->

🧭 A saved route keeps its stops, and can be navigated again from its track.

Switch `GroveTrips`, on by default, at once. Off, or with Stock on, upstream's code runs.
